title: Expedition 33 Lune Build - Best Skills & Strategy
description: Complete Lune build guide for Expedition 33 covering all elemental skills, Stain mechanics, best weapons, Pictos, and party synergies for optimal damage.

sections.title: Lune Overview & Elemental Stain Mechanic
sections.content:
Lune is the first party member to rejoin Gustave after the Prologue and serves as Expedition 33's primary spellcaster. She combines powerful offensive magic, party healing, and enemy debuffs into one highly versatile package.

Elemental Stain System

Lune's unique mechanic revolves around generating and consuming Elemental Stains. There are five elements — Fire, Cold, Lightning, Earth, and Light. Each element generates a Stain of its own type when cast. The opposing element then consumes that Stain for bonus effects:

  • Fire Stains — consumed by Lightning skills for increased damage and extra hits
  • Earth Stains — consumed by Cold skills for reduced AP cost or additional turns
  • Mixed Stains — consumed by multi-element skills like Mayhem for raw burst damage

Mastering this generate-and-consume cycle is the key to unlocking Lune's full potential. Plan your skill rotation two moves ahead — use a Fire skill, then follow up with Lightning to consume the Fire Stain for amplified damage.

sections.title: Fire Skills
sections.content:
Fire is Lune's most supportive element due to the Burn status effect it applies. Burn stacks boost the entire party's damage when combined with Burn-synergy Pictos and ally abilities.

  • Immolation: Low-cost Fire spell applying 3 Burn stacks. The damage is modest, but the Burn application enables Critical Burn (+25% crit chance) and Healing Fire (25% HP restored when attacking Burned enemies) for your whole team. A staple early-game opener.
  • Wildfire: Your go-to AoE Fire spell in the early game. Particularly devastating against Fire-weak enemy groups. Becomes less essential once you unlock Hell.
  • Fire Rage: High-risk, high-reward burst damage. Continues dealing damage each subsequent turn as long as Lune doesn't take a hit. Excellent against bosses where you've mastered their attack patterns.
  • Hell: Lune's ultimate Fire nuke. Hits all enemies multiple times, applies 10 Burn stacks, but costs enormous AP. Best used on Turn 1 with Energising Turn or Energising Start Lumina effects to front-load AP. One of the strongest opening moves in the game.

sections.title: Cold Skills
sections.content:
Cold skills provide utility through the Slow debuff and pair especially well with Earth Stain consumption for extra turns or AP savings.

  • Ice Lance: Solid single-target Cold damage with built-in Slow. Note that Slow can be a double-edged sword — slower enemies give fewer Parry opportunities for AP generation. Best against bosses with fast multi-hit attacks.
  • Thermal Transfer: An AP-efficient multi-hit Cold utility skill. When targeting Burned enemies, it refunds AP (essentially free casts). Consuming Earth Stains grants extra turns. A cornerstone of Cold/Earth hybrid builds.
  • Crippling Tsunami: AoE version of Ice Lance. Clears groups of enemies efficiently in early and mid-game. The Slow debuff applied to all enemies gives your party breathing room.
  • Typhoon: Expensive but powerful hybrid spell dealing high Cold damage per turn while healing the entire party. Best combined with Earth skills to build and consume Earth Stains. Ideal for prolonged boss fights where sustain matters.

sections.title: Lightning Skills
sections.content:
Lightning skills are Lune's highest single-target DPS option, especially when consuming Fire Stains for bonus damage and extra hits.

  • Thunderfall: Outstanding early and mid-game damage. Scales extremely well with Luck/Crit Lune builds thanks to Critical Burn synergy. Consuming Fire Stains boosts its damage even further — always cast a Fire spell first.
  • Electrify: Low AP cost (reducible to 0 with the Deminerim weapon). Spammable filler for maintaining pressure between expensive skills. Free damage when combined with the right weapon.
  • Lightning Dance: A more reliable and powerful version of Electrify. Guarantees 6 strikes on a single target, with crits extending it up to 12 hits total. This is Lune's premier boss-killing skill when combined with Fire Stain consumption.
  • Storm Caller: Multi-turn Lightning that hits twice per round when consuming Fire Stains. Functions best as a "set and forget" support skill while your other party members deal primary damage. Less hands-on than Lightning Dance but still effective.

sections.title: Earth Skills
sections.content:
Earth skills focus on the Break mechanic, allowing you to stagger bosses and interrupt their most dangerous attacks.

  • Earth Rising: One of Lune's earliest AoE options. Low damage but available early. Outclassed by Wildfire quickly, but useful if enemies resist Fire.
  • Rockslide: Single-target Earth damage with significant Break buildup. Excellent for shutting down bosses before their big attacks. A reliable choice throughout the entire game.
  • Crustal Crush: Heavy single-target Earth damage with massive Break accumulation. Combined with another party member's Break skills, you can stagger bosses multiple times in one fight. Core skill for Break-focused strategies.
  • Terraquake: AoE Earth that builds Break on all targets and increases future Break buildup. Situational — primarily useful against multi-boss encounters where you need to stagger everyone simultaneously.

sections.title: Multi-Element & Support Skills
sections.content:
Multi-Element Skills

  • Mayhem: Consumes all active Stains for high burst damage at low AP cost. Can also Break enemies. Use after stacking 3-4 Stains for respectable damage without committing to a single element.
  • Elemental Trick: Generates 4 Stains with a single cast (requires Critical Hit). Low cost and essential for setting up Elemental Genesis combos. Build Luck to ensure consistent Stain generation.
  • Elemental Genesis: The ultimate Stain payoff skill. Consumes all Stains for massive damage scaling. The ideal combo is Elemental Trick → stack Stains → Elemental Genesis for devastating single-target burst.

Support Skills

  • Healing Light: Basic single-target heal with status effect removal. Useful early on, though Elixirs are often more AP-efficient in the late game.
  • Rebirth: Revive a fallen party member with AP grant. Emergency use only — preventing death is always better.
  • Revitalization: Heals the entire party and can apply Regeneration when combined with Fire support. One of Lune's most universally useful skills across all builds.

Gradient Skills

  • Tremor: Removes enemy shields. Niche but critical against shielded bosses.
  • Tree of Life: Full party heal and status cleanse. Excellent panic button in dire situations.
  • Sky Break: Large AoE nuke that lets you choose the element and inflicts Break. Powerful but usually outclassed by dedicated element combos for Gradient spending.

sections.title: Best Weapons
sections.content:
Lune's weapon determines which element she specializes in. Each weapon family boosts damage of its corresponding element and provides unique passive bonuses at upgrade milestones.

For general use, Trebuchim offers the most flexibility early-to-mid game. In the endgame, Esquim or Cleim enable the highest damage ceilings.

sections.title: Pictos & Lumina
sections.content:
Lune benefits from Pictos that boost her spellcasting output and AP efficiency. Here are the recommended choices:

Offensive Pictos

  • Energising Start I-IV: Extra AP at the start of battle. Essential for opening with Hell or other expensive spells.
  • Critical Burn: Grants +25% crit chance to all allies attacking Burned enemies. Since Lune applies Burn so easily, this benefits the entire party.
  • Burn Affinity: +25% damage to all allies against Burned targets. Stacks with Critical Burn for massive party-wide DPS increases.

Support Pictos

  • Healing Fire: All party members restore 25% HP when attacking Burned enemies. Combined with Immolation, this provides passive healing to your entire team without spending AP on heals.
  • Augmented Counter: Stronger counterattacks after successful parries.

Lumina Priorities

Equip Energising Turn effects on Lune first. Extra AP generation means more spells per turn, which means more Stains and more damage. After AP is covered, stack elemental damage bonuses matching your weapon choice.

sections.title: Build Synergies
sections.content:
Lune's Burn support alone makes her valuable in any party composition. Here are the strongest character pairings:

Lune + Maelle

Lune casts Immolation to apply Burn → Maelle uses Swift Stride or Combustion for amplified damage. Maelle's Burn-synergy skills deal devastating damage against Burned targets, especially in Virtuose Stance.

Lune + Sciel

Sciel's Searing Bond benefits from Burn stacks on enemies. Lune applies Burn while Sciel stacks Foretell, then both capitalize on the debuffed enemy for massive burst turns.

Lune + Verso

Verso's From Fire skill consumes Burn stacks for bonus Perfection Rank. Lune applies Burn, Verso consumes it for instant Rank progression toward S-Rank damage.

Self-Synergy Combos

  • Fire → Lightning: Cast a Fire skill, then use Lightning Dance or Thunderfall to consume the Fire Stain for extra damage/hits. The strongest self-contained DPS rotation.
  • Earth → Cold: Build Earth Stains, then consume them with Cold skills for reduced AP costs or extra turns. Best for sustained fights.
  • Elemental Trick → Elemental Genesis: Generate 4 Stains cheaply, then consume them all for burst damage. The highest single-turn output combo.

Weapon-Element Alignment

Match your weapon to your most-used element for maximum synergy. Use Kralim if you want flexibility across all elements without committing to one specialization.
